Italian

[edit]
Italian Wikipedia has an article on:
nudo
Wikipedia it

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin nūdus.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈnu.do/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -udo
  • Hyphenation: nù‧do

Adjective

[edit]

nudo (feminine nuda, masculine plural nudi, feminine plural nude)

  1. naked, nude, bare
    Synonym: ignudo
    Antonym: (of a person) vestito

Derived terms

[edit]
  • mettere a nudo
  • nudamente
  • nudismo
  • nudista
  • nudo e crudo
  • occhio nudo

Related terms

[edit]
  • nudità
  • seminudo

Noun

[edit]

nudo m (plural nudi)

  1. (art) nude

Anagrams

[edit]
  • udon

Latin

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Classical Latin) IPA(key): [ˈnuː.doː]
  • (modern Italianate Ecclesiastical) IPA(key): [ˈnuː.do]

Etymology 1

[edit]

From nūdus (“naked”) +‎ -ō.

Verb

[edit]

nūdō (present infinitive nūdāre, perfect active nūdāvī, supine nūdātum); first conjugation

  1. to strip, bare, nake, make naked
    Synonyms: spoliō, exuō, dēvestiō
    Antonyms: velō, indūcō, induō, saepiō, sūmō
  2. to leave exposed, leave defenseless
  3. (figuratively) to spoil, plunder
  4. (figuratively) to deprive, bereave of
    Synonyms: prīvō, dēturbō, tondeō, dēstringō, fraudō, adimō

Spanish

[edit]
Spanish Wikipedia has an article on:
nudo
Wikipedia es

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈnudo/ [ˈnu.ð̞o]
  • Rhymes: -udo
  • Syllabification: nu‧do

Etymology 1

[edit]
Spanish Wikipedia has an article on:
nudo (unidad)
Wikipedia es

From Vulgar Latin *nūdus, from Latin nōdus, from Proto-Indo-European *gned-, *gnod- (“to bind”). Compare to Portuguese nó. Doublet of nodo. Also compare English noose.

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • ñudo (uncommon)

Noun

[edit]

nudo m (plural nudos)

  1. knot (a looping piece of a long, flexible material)
  2. knot (nautical unit of speed)

[edit]
  • nudillo
  • nudo corredizo
  • nudo de ocho
  • nudo de rizo
  • nudo en la garganta
  • nudo gordiano
  • nudo llano
  • teoría de nudos
Related terms
[edit]
  • anudar

Etymology 2

[edit]

From Latin nūdus.

Adjective

[edit]

nudo (feminine nuda, masculine plural nudos, feminine plural nudas)

  1. (formal) nude
    Synonym: desnudo
